answer: Reputation Ripple Ledger: each identity's score is a declining dividend of the scores it interacts with, recomputed every epoch like a sonnet's meter. Duplicate identities start at zero and gain only from verified counterparties, so cloning yields no weight until costly genuine trades accrue. An honest identity inherits a small yarrow of trust once its neighbors confirm it, while an attacker must fund full interaction histories per clone—roughly 40 verified exchanges each—making N clones cost N times the honest path.
